note: Small-sample (413 pairs) rho=-0.097 was an artifact; with 3,393 pairs, ratio vs MI = +0.78 (ratio is a monotone-ish transform of MI). Both ratio and MI are nearly uncorrelated with DCA Frobenius direct couplings (rho ~ 0.05): MI-type measures capture total correlation, DCA captures direct coupling. Perplexity adds interpretability (effective number of choices) and determinism (conditional PP ~ 1), not independent ranking information.
